name: screenshare
description: Let students put their own screen on the classroom projector. Claude runs a small WebRTC relay on the classroom computer and publishes it over a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel, so students join from an HTTPS link on their own laptops and you choose who is shown. Video goes peer-to-peer when the campus network allows it and falls back to a TURN relay when it doesn't. Runs on Windows, macOS or Linux, and can fetch its own cloudflared on a locked-down machine without admin rights.
